info.title: Workflow Builder API — Phase 1 draft
info.description: Health, public config, GET /api/v1/me and workflow CRUD/revision routes GET /api/v1/ai/limits and AI generate/edit are implemented; restore and AI operations remain planning specifications. Workflow v1 structure is shared with the runtime contract; draft persistence and AI payload/policy decisions remain explicit TBD. Firebase client owns registration/login/password handling. Browser owns validation and simulation. No cloud resources are provisioned.

post.summary: Propose workflow generate without saving or applying it
post.description: Implemented in Phase 5 (WB-019, ADR-023). Verified members only, one request per UTC day, global 4.50 USD stop. Requires Idempotency-Key (8–128 [A-Za-z0-9_-], scoped per user); a repeated key replays the stored answer without a provider call. The proposal is never applied or saved by the server.

post.summary: Propose workflow edit without saving or applying it
post.description: Implemented in Phase 5 (WB-020, ADR-024). Same access, quota, budget and Idempotency-Key rules as generate. baseContentHash must equal the hash of the sent workflow (409 STALE_PROPOSAL); the client re-checks it before applying. Operations are canonical (D-11) and applied atomically by the pure core patch engine; unchanged IDs are preserved.

200.description: Validated edit proposal with semantic diff.

get.summary: Coarse AI availability and remaining usage; never expose secrets or raw ledger
get.description: Implemented in Phase 5 (WB-017). Members only (no guest AI); one request per UTC day; coarse budget state without ledger totals. AI off when AI_ENABLED is not "true", the email is unverified or the ledger is unavailable.

firebaseBearer.description: Worker validates signature and claims; ownership comes from token sub, never client owner_uid.

PlannedResponse.description: TBD: response payload will be finalized in the owning phase; this is not an implemented contract.

baseContentHash.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; the server relies on expectedRevision.

Workflow.description: Workflow v1 structural schema. Runtime parsing additionally checks UTF-8 bytes, safe JSON trees, unique identifiers, calendar dates, input bounds/defaults and option uniqueness. Executability requires workflow-core validation.

Error500.description: Unexpected internal error; no stack or raw input is exposed.

Error400.description: Invalid JSON/request or unsupported schema version.

Error401.description: Invalid or expired Firebase ID token.

Error404.description: Resource absent or owned by someone else; never disclose foreign data.

Error403.description: Feature disabled; email verification policy TBD (D-05).

Error413.description: Graph/prompt size limit exceeded; precise envelope size TBD (D-02).

Error429.description: Quota, rate or budget limit; thresholds/policy TBD (D-05/D-07).

Error503.description: Provider or budget ledger unavailable; fail closed.
